policy.description: Content guard for an agent's generation path (in-circuit kinds only).
Guard for an agent's tool-call path (Python reference kinds).
Example pack in the spirit of EU AI Act Art.12/13: ban high-risk output, no PII, bounded disclosure.
Example pack for a financial-advice channel: no high-leverage solicitation, no credentials, bounded length.

P2-11 demo: one policy whose rules fall to two different roles — content rules (keyword/length) belong to the model side, tool rules (tool_arg_guard/budget_bound) to the tool gateway. Neither role can prove the other's slice, so the certificate needs both signatures and both proofs (policydsl/proofs/multiparty.py::shard).
PII redaction example pack: block emails, phone numbers, and secret credentials in agent output.

P2-9 demo: a learned semantic rule (weaponize/harmful-intent) alongside in-circuit rules. The length_bound is not optional — the feature graph is fixed-width, so the policy must itself bound the response to the graph's capacity (see policydsl/core/compile.py::require_covering_length_bound).
